mentions.name: Metaphysical essays Substack
mentions.description: A Substack publication of essays on metaphysical and esoteric topics — spirituality, religion, psychedelics, tarot — written under a new account deliberately kept separate from the author's real-name public tech persona.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a worry-free outlet for writing about weird, woo-y, or controversial topics that wouldn't fit on their professional site tied to their real name.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've got this new account and a Substack page where I'm writing about, idk... metaphysical stuff? Spirituality, religion, psychedelics, tarot, and so forth.
